title: Enterprise Control Mapping v1 — Rig Relay

control_families.family_name: NIST SSDF (SP 800-218) Secure Software Development Practices

controls.requirement_summary: Define security requirements for software development
controls.gap: Security requirements exist in threat model but not as a standalone security requirements document.
controls.remediation_action: Create formal security requirements specification.
controls.validation_method: Review security requirements doc against SSDF practices.

controls.requirement_summary: Use appropriate threat modeling to identify threats
controls.gap: Threat model v0 covers 17 threats with mitigations. Needs periodic review.
controls.remediation_action: Schedule periodic threat model reviews.
controls.validation_method: Verify threat model updated within review cadence.

controls.requirement_summary: Store all forms of code based on the principle of least privilege
controls.gap: Dirty-file preservation exists but no RBAC for repository access.
controls.remediation_action: Implement RBAC model for repository operations.

controls.requirement_summary: Use version control and track all changes
controls.gap: Exemplary: checkpoint-only commits, dirty-file preservation, no direct git mutations.
controls.validation_method: Verify all changes tracked via git with checkpoint governance.

controls.requirement_summary: Use automated testing to check for vulnerabilities
controls.gap: CodeQL runs but no dependency vulnerability scanning. Test coverage unknown.
controls.remediation_action: Add pip-audit/safety to CI; measure and improve test coverage.
controls.validation_method: CI passes with vulnerability scanning green.

controls.gap: CODEOWNERS exists but no documented code review process. Single-maintainer project.
controls.remediation_action: Document code review requirements; require PR reviews.
controls.validation_method: PR review requirements enforced in branch protection.

controls.requirement_summary: Build code from verified, trusted sources
controls.gap: Dependencies pinned via uv.lock but no dependency verification or provenance checks.
controls.remediation_action: Add dependency verification; implement SLSA provenance.
controls.validation_method: CI verifies dependency integrity before build.

controls.requirement_summary: Verify acquired software complies with security requirements
controls.gap: No software composition analysis or SBOM verification pipeline.
controls.remediation_action: Implement SBOM generation and verification.
controls.validation_method: SBOM validated against dependency policy in CI.

controls.gap: WebSocket auth and local-only binding are good. No RBAC, no MFA, no session management.
controls.remediation_action: Implement RBAC; add MFA capability; document session management.
controls.validation_method: Access control audit; RBAC enforcement tests.

controls.gap: No user management. Single-local-user only. No deprovisioning.
controls.remediation_action: Implement user management; document provisioning/deprovisioning.

controls.requirement_summary: System event monitoring and anomaly detection
controls.gap: Structured observability exists but no anomaly detection or alerting.
controls.remediation_action: Add anomaly detection for agent behavior; set up alerting pipeline.
controls.validation_method: Anomaly detection tests with known-bad patterns.

controls.gap: Checkpoint-only commits, dirty-file preservation, no amend/force-push. Exemplary change control for agent-driven development.
Content-light doctrine strong. No formal confidentiality commitments for enterprise data. No DPA.
controls.remediation_action: Draft DPA; strengthen privacy commitments in legal docs.
controls.validation_method: Legal review of DPA and privacy docs.

controls.requirement_summary: Processing integrity — complete, accurate, timely, authorized
controls.gap: Receipt-backed evidence provides integrity. No input validation completeness guarantee.
controls.remediation_action: Document processing integrity guarantees; add completeness checks.

controls.gap: Security policy exists but not at ISMS breadth. Missing asset management, supplier security, HR security policies.
controls.remediation_action: Expand security policy framework to cover all ISMS domains.
controls.validation_method: Policy completeness review against ISO 27001 Annex A.

controls.gap: AGENTS.md defines secure development conventions. No formal SSDLC integration.
controls.remediation_action: Integrate security gates into development lifecycle.

controls.gap: OAuth providers exist. No password policy, no MFA, no brute-force protection.
controls.remediation_action: Document authentication policy; add MFA; add brute-force protection.

controls.gap: No business continuity or disaster recovery planning.
controls.remediation_action: Create business continuity plan for hosted deployment.

controls.gap: Bash pattern detection and binary rejection exist. No malware scanning on dependencies.
controls.remediation_action: Add malware scanning for dependencies.

controls.gap: GitHub Actions provides scripted builds for 5 platforms.

controls.requirement_summary: Provenance showing how artifacts were built
controls.gap: No provenance generation. Build manifest exists but not SLSA-compliant.
controls.remediation_action: Generate SLSA provenance attestations for all builds.

controls.requirement_summary: Signed provenance from hosted build platform
controls.gap: GitHub Actions OIDC available but not used for signing.
controls.remediation_action: Implement OIDC-based build attestation signing.

controls.requirement_summary: Hardened build platform with hermetic builds
controls.gap: SLSA L3 requires hardened build infrastructure. Not applicable for alpha-stage tool.
controls.remediation_action: Defer to enterprise beta phase.

controls.gap: CI runs on PRs but branch protection status unknown. Need to verify require-PR, require-review, require-status-checks.
controls.remediation_action: Enable branch protection with required reviews and status checks.

controls.gap: Release artifacts not cryptographically signed.
controls.remediation_action: Sign release artifacts with cosign or GPG.

controls.gap: CODEOWNERS defined. Single-maintainer project limits meaningful review. PR requirements unclear.
controls.remediation_action: Enforce PR review requirement; expand maintainer base.

controls.gap: SECURITY.md exists. CodeQL runs. Missing: dependency scanning, OSV integration.
controls.remediation_action: Add OSV-Scanner or Dependabot for dependency vulnerabilities.

controls.gap: No Dependabot or Renovate configured.
controls.remediation_action: Configure Dependabot with grouped PR strategy.

controls.gap: No SBOM generation or publication.
controls.remediation_action: Generate SPDX SBOM; publish with releases.

controls.gap: CodeQL SAST runs in CI for Python and JavaScript. Ruff linting in CI equivalent.
Python deps pinned via uv.lock. GitHub Actions pinned by SHA. NPM deps (if any) unknown.
controls.remediation_action: Verify all CI actions pinned by SHA; pin any NPM deps.

control_families.reference_standard: NTIA SBOM Minimum Elements / SPDX 2.3 / CycloneDX 1.5

controls.gap: No SBOM generation pipeline. Python dependencies from pyproject.toml/uv.lock need extraction.
controls.remediation_action: Implement SPDX SBOM generation from uv.lock.

controls.requirement_summary: Include license and vulnerability metadata in SBOM
controls.gap: No license or vulnerability data attached to dependencies.
controls.remediation_action: Enrich SBOM with license data from PyPI metadata; integrate vulnerability data.
controls.validation_method: SBOM includes license and vulnerability fields.

controls.gap: No SBOM published.
controls.remediation_action: Attach SBOM to GitHub releases; publish in repo.
controls.validation_method: SBOM present in latest release assets.

controls.requirement_summary: Preserve dirty files from parallel agent lanes
controls.gap: Dirty-file guard implemented and enforced.

controls.requirement_summary: No raw content in telemetry, traces, or exports
controls.gap: Comprehensive content-light doctrine with redaction validator.

controls.requirement_summary: Evidence must be JSON/JSONL/CSV, not Markdown
controls.gap: Policy enforced. 461 JSON artifacts exist.

controls.requirement_summary: Only checkpoint tool may create commits
controls.gap: Direct git add/commit blocked via bash rerouting.

controls.requirement_summary: All artifacts governed by JSON schemas
controls.gap: 404 schemas govern all artifact types. Schema validation in CI.

controls.requirement_summary: Product telemetry is first-party, default-on, and opt-out. Remote telemetry contribution is separately controlled. Content-light and no-raw-content controls are mandatory. Enterprise policy may disable remote contribution. Audit/evidence continuity remains mandatory.
controls.gap: Four-category model (product telemetry, remote contribution, local operational observability, enterprise audit/evidence) needs formalization in governance artifacts. Cockpit must visibly distinguish these states.
controls.validation_method: Verify product-telemetry opt-out preserves governance/audit/evidence. Verify remote contribution disabled preserves local observability.
